title: Media Happy Post — owner-scoped Expo media feed
description: A minimal Expo SDK 57 acceptance vehicle for owner-scoped profile avatars and ordered image/video post collections through generated Snapback media commands and delivery hooks.

backend.stalenessPolicy: committed; regenerate with codegen; freshness tracked by artifacts.json inputsHash

expo: two development-only session personas sign in to isolated owner-principal feeds
an image picker updates the profile avatar through v.media and useSnapbackMedia
a multi-select image/video picker drives the generated createPost command with per-item progress
text-only posts commit with no media input
postMediaList and useSnapbackMediaCollection render ordered sibling-local delivery states

capabilityGaps: physical-device reachability is an operator-run source path, not a receipt produced by this phase
video items are labeled delivery tiles; playback is intentionally not claimed
LAN binding is an unsupported local-development workaround

capabilityGapsBoundary.reason: These entries are explicit boundaries of this source acceptance vehicle, not platform GAP rows.

notClaiming: a physical-device run in this phase
